findings.detail: Beef booked at 2155 g (4 3/4 lb) vs the exact 14/3 scale of 1 lb = 2117 g, an implied ratio of 4.75x vs the recipe's 4.667x (+1.8%). All other lines sit on the 4.667x ratio exactly (salsa 2 1/3 cups/560 g, cabbage 9 1/3 cups/653 g, cheese 3 1/2 cups/396 g, chili powder 3 tbsp/24 g). Consistent with rounding the beef to a purchasable quarter-pound increment, not a per-line guess; noting for the auditor.

notes: Re-certification against current spec bytes; prior 06:16 cert void. Both anchors reached: extraction and live heyketomama.com page agree exactly (title, 3 servings, all 7 ingredient lines, 5 steps).
